five_second.sells: online courses and coaching in a manifesting/drawing method (NeuroGraphica, Art of Manifesting) - not obviously a bookstore or any kind of product shop
five_second.for_whom: people into spiritual self-development, mindfulness, and creative wellness practices
five_second.price_guess: no price visible on this first screen at all - just email signup forms

errand.abandoned_at: Resources page, after using the Books category filter and confirming every book link on the site (including the one my sister wants) routes out to Amazon with no on-site cart or checkout
errand.abandon_trigger: no direct purchase path exists on annadenning.com for the book - it only exists as an Amazon affiliate link inside a general 'Resources and Favorite Drawing Tools' page, so there was nothing left to do here except leave for Amazon, which I won't do inside this errand

features_used.moment: opened the hamburger menu right away hoping for a Shop or Store link, but only found course and content pages (Courses, Blog, Resources, Library, Membership)
clicked it thinking it was about the book my sister wants, but it was actually a 4-month coaching certification programme priced 997 to 1997 in various currencies

eventually found the exact book - 'The Art of Manifesting: A Meditative Drawing Practice to Rewire Your Brain and Create Your Reality' by Colette Baron-Reid with Anna Denning - inside a personal recommendations page, with an upfront Amazon Associate disclosure right above it
clicked it and landed straight on an Amazon page carrying an annadenning08-20 affiliate tag, which matched exactly what the disclosure had said would happen

features_used.feature: Books category filter on Resources page
features_used.moment: checked whether there were other on-site ways to buy the book, but the filter just showed more unrelated titles that also linked out to Amazon

features_looked_for_but_missing: a Shop or Store link in the main menu
an on-site product page or cart for the book
any price for the book shown on annadenning.com itself
feature_that_most_helped_the_decision: The Resources page's 'The Book' section, which gave the full title, co-author, and a clearly labeled Buy on Amazon link so I could confirm it was the right book
feature_that_most_hurt_the_decision: There is no Shop or Store link anywhere in the main menu, so I had to guess my way through a coaching-certification page before stumbling onto the book inside a general affiliate resources page

friction.moment: No Shop or Store section in the main menu even though I came here specifically to buy something
Clicking 'Art of Manifesting Method' led to a 997-1997 coaching certification course instead of the book, a wasted detour
The book is buried inside a general 'Resources and Favorite Drawing Tools' affiliate page instead of having its own findable listing
No price for the book is shown anywhere on annadenning.com itself - I'd have to go to Amazon just to see what it costs

delight.moment: The Amazon Associate disclosure sat right above the book link, plainly worded, before I even clicked anything

what_earned_it: clear, upfront Amazon Associate disclosure before any affiliate links
the book title, author, and co-author matched exactly what I was looking for
the 'Buy on Amazon' link was labeled plainly, not disguised as an on-site purchase
trust.what_it_would_take: a real Shop or Store section with a dedicated page for the book (cover, price, buy options) instead of only surfacing it inside a general drawing-supplies affiliate roundup

brand_recall.tell_a_friend_one_sentence: It's mainly an online course site for a manifesting/drawing method, and the book she wanted is just an Amazon affiliate link buried on a general resources page, not something you can actually buy on the site itself.
brand_recall.product_remembered: The Art of Manifesting (the manifesting drawing book with Colette Baron-Reid)
brand_recall.price_remembered: none shown for the book itself - I only recall the unrelated coaching certification being priced around 997 to 1997
